name: Ultimate Big Chill
abilities: Ice-flame breath and hand beams: plasma 'fire so cold it burns' that absorbs heat and flash-freezes
Intangibility, invisibility and cryo-phasing (freezing what he phases through)
Enhanced strength and durability over Big Chill
weaknesses: Still a light-bodied flyer that can be swatted by giants (sentient version smacked by Way Big)
summary: The evolved Necrofriggian: Big Chill recoloured in flame-red with a breath of freezing blue plasma that flash-freezes air, builds ice constructs and can be phased straight into a target.
traits: Wings and antennae fold into a cloak
notableFeats: Defeated Vulkanus and his Pickaxe Alien minions on debut (Hit 'Em Where They Live)
Battled Galapagus with ice-flame vortexes and cryo-phasing (Escape From Aggregor)
Chased Ultimate Aggregor and defeated the Piscciss Volann core guards (Deep)
Froze Zarkovian soldiers before being beaten by the undead Dr. Viktor (Viktor: The Spoils)
Fought a Techadon Robot and defeated the Esoterica (Greetings From Techadon; The Flame Keepers' Circle)

appearances.designNotes: Same body as UAF Big Chill but skin recoloured red; wings and antennae carry a flame pattern and there are flame-shaped crests over the eyes; wings still fold into a cloak; evolved Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

image.label: UA
image.notes: Infobox render, wings open. Cloaked alternative: 'Ultimate Big Chill Official Artwork (2).png'.

scoring.rationale: Ice flames flash-freeze the air around a target, build constructs and vortexes, and cryo-phasing freezes from the inside; keeps flight, intangibility and invisibility, so offense and defense both jump over Big Chill. Electricity (Dr. Viktor) still drops him and he is not physically imposing.

notes: UA-only form; never used in AF or OV (Derrick J. Wyatt mused about weather powers had Albedo used it in OV, but it never appeared).
Comic-only freeze rays from hands (Cartoon Network Action Pack) are non-canon and excluded.

Sentient Ultimates storyline (UA S3, 'The Ultimate Sacrifice'): the six most-used Ultimate forms (Humungousaur, Swampfire, Spidermonkey, Big Chill, Cannonbolt, Echo Echo) gained sentience inside the Ultimatrix and demanded freedom; Ben offered his life, Azmuth freed them to their own world and reworked the Ultimatrix so Ultimates are 'empty shells' again.

Ultimate forms are artificial by-products of the Ultimatrix's evolutionary function (added by Albedo): the DNA is run through a simulated worst-case scenario over millions of theoretical years to force combat-oriented evolution. They are not natural Codon Stream species, and the Omniverse Omnitrix has no evolutionary function, so Ben never regains them after UA (Derrick J. Wyatt).
